criteria.title: Disc and region identity
criteria.acceptance: Reject unsupported editions; locate the exact game data partition.

criteria.title: Archive resource addressing
criteria.acceptance: Resolve every resource by hash/name and validate complete payloads.

criteria.title: EDB resource sections
criteria.acceptance: Decode version 263 headers and all referenced section ranges.

criteria.title: Textures and palettes
criteria.acceptance: Compare decoded mipmaps, palettes, alpha, and swizzling to reference.

criteria.title: World and character geometry
criteria.acceptance: Preserve vertex data, indices, materials, transforms, and LODs.

criteria.title: Skeletons and animation
criteria.acceptance: Match poses, blend behavior, timing, and root motion.

criteria.title: Audio resources
criteria.acceptance: Match sample decode, loop points, channels, rates, and localization.

criteria.title: Scene rendering
criteria.acceptance: Reference captures match camera, culling, transforms, and draw ordering.

criteria.title: Materials and lighting
criteria.acceptance: Match lighting, shading, fog, transparency, and shadows.

criteria.title: Particles and effects
criteria.acceptance: Match particles, decals, water, explosions, and post-processing.

criteria.title: HUD and menus
criteria.acceptance: Match layout, fonts, navigation, safe areas, aspect ratios, and transitions.

criteria.title: Movies and cinematics
criteria.acceptance: Match video/audio sync, subtitles, camera tracks, and skip behavior.

criteria.title: Simulation timing
criteria.acceptance: Match original tick/timing semantics and display-independent behavior.

criteria.title: Player movement
criteria.acceptance: Compare trajectories, acceleration, crouching, leaning, and traversal.

criteria.title: Collision and physics
criteria.acceptance: Compare collision, gravity, rigid bodies, projectiles, and penetration.

criteria.title: Camera and aiming
criteria.acceptance: Match FOV, recoil, aim assist, view bob, and input response.

criteria.title: World interactions
criteria.acceptance: Match doors, ladders, scripted traversal, pickups, and use prompts.

criteria.title: All weapon behaviors
criteria.acceptance: Inventory and match fire modes, damage, spread, recoil, and attachments.

criteria.title: Ammunition and reloads

criteria.title: Damage and recovery

criteria.title: Melee and stealth
criteria.acceptance: Match takedowns, detection consequences, animations, and damage.

criteria.title: Destructible objects
criteria.acceptance: Match breakage, explosions, chain reactions, and persistent state.

criteria.title: Perception and alerts
criteria.acceptance: Match sight/hearing, suspicion, search, and alert propagation.

criteria.title: Navigation and cover
criteria.acceptance: Match path selection, traversal, cover selection, and avoidance.

criteria.title: Enemy combat

criteria.title: Allied behavior

criteria.title: Complete content inventory
